statement: For the displayed 19-variable tensor A=U plus kt, A^3=U of dimension 18, U^3=W of dimension 7, mu(W,U,U)=0, the all-layer associative closure on U is M18, and the multiplication Lie algebra is sl18; the symplectic alternative is excluded by a full-rank 153-variable certificate.
title: The Nineteen-Variable Tensor Has an sl18 Codimension-One Core
